info.title: T2A V2 WebSocket API
info.description: WebSocket API for real-time text-to-speech streaming using T2A V2 model

production.description: Production WebSocket server for T2A V2 streaming

ReceiveConnectedSuccess.name: ReceiveConnectedSuccess
ReceiveConnectedSuccess.title: Connected Success Event
ReceiveConnectedSuccess.summary: Notification that T2A task has started

SendTaskStart.name: TaskStart
SendTaskStart.title: Task Start Event
SendTaskStart.summary: Sending the `"task_start"` event officially begins the speech synthesis task. The task is considered successfully started when the server returns a `"task_started"` event. Only after receiving this event can you send `"task_continue"` or `"task_finish"` events to the server.

ReceiveTaskStarted.name: ReceiveTaskStarted
ReceiveTaskStarted.title: Task Started Event
ReceiveTaskStarted.summary: Notification that T2A task has started

SendTaskContinue.name: TaskContinue
SendTaskContinue.title: Task Continue Event
SendTaskContinue.summary: After receiving the `"task_started"` event from the server, the task officially begins. You can send `"task_continue"` events to provide text for synthesis. Multiple `"task_continue"` events can be sent sequentially. If no new event is sent within 120 seconds after receiving the last result, the WebSocket connection will automatically close.

payload.text: Omg(sighs), the real danger is not that computers start thinking like people, but that people start thinking like computers. Computers can only help us with simple tasks.

ReceiveTaskContinued.name: ReceiveTaskContinued
ReceiveTaskContinued.title: Task Continued Event
ReceiveTaskContinued.summary: Notification that T2A task is continuing

SendTaskFinish.name: TaskFinish
SendTaskFinish.title: Task Finish Event
SendTaskFinish.summary: When the server receives the `task_finish` event, it waits for all tasks in the current queue to complete, then closes the WebSocket connection and ends the session.

ReceiveTaskFinished.name: ReceiveTaskFinished
ReceiveTaskFinished.title: Task Finished Event
ReceiveTaskFinished.summary: Notification that T2A task has completed successfully

ReceiveTaskFailed.name: ReceiveTaskFailed
ReceiveTaskFailed.title: Task Failed Event
ReceiveTaskFailed.summary: If the `task_failed` event is received, it indicates that the task has failed. In this case, the WebSocket connection must be closed, and the error should be handled.

session_id.description: The ID of the entire session.

event.description: The type of session event. Returns `connected_success` upon successful connection.

trace_id.description: The ID of a single request within the session, useful for troubleshooting or feedback.

event.description: Controls the instruction being sent. For this step, set to `task_start`.

model.description: The model version to request. Options: `speech-2.8-hd`, `speech-2.8-turbo`, `speech-2.6-hd`, `speech-2.6-turbo`, `speech-02-hd`, `speech-02-turbo`, `speech-01-hd`, `speech-01-turbo`.

language_boost.description:
Controls whether recognition for specific minority languages and dialects is enhanced.  Default is `null`. If the language type is unknown, set to `"auto"` and the model will automatically detect it.  
Supported values:  
[`Chinese`, `Chinese,Yue`, `English`, `Arabic`, `Russian`, `Spanish`, `French`, `Portuguese`, `German`, `Turkish`, `Dutch`, `Ukrainian`, `Vietnamese`, `Indonesian`, `Japanese`, `Italian`, `Korean`, `Thai`, `Polish`, `Romanian`, `Greek`, `Czech`, `Finnish`, `Hindi`, `Bulgarian`, `Danish`, `Hebrew`, `Malay`, `Persian`, `Slovak`, `Swedish`, `Croatian`, `Filipino`, `Hungarian`, `Norwegian`, `Slovenian`, `Catalan`, `Nynorsk`, `Tamil`, `Afrikaans`, `auto`]

Note: The speech-01 and speech-02 series models do not currently support Persian, Filipino, or Tamil.

subtitle_enable.description: Controls whether subtitles are enabled. Default is `false`. Available for models: `speech-2.8-hd`, `speech-2.8-turbo`, `speech-2.6-hd`, `speech-2.6-turbo`, `speech-02-hd`, `speech-02-turbo`, `speech-01-hd`, `speech-01-turbo`.

subtitle_type.description:
Subtitle granularity. Default is `sentence`. Options:
- `sentence`: sentence-level timestamps
- `word`: word-level timestamps
- `word_streaming`: word-level timestamps optimized for streaming

continuous_sound.description:
Controls model-side text segmentation strategy. Only available for `speech-2.8-hd` and `speech-2.8-turbo` models.
- `true`: model does not split the text and performs continuous inference to generate audio (better prosody for long text)
- `false`: model splits the text and runs concurrent inference for each segment (lower latency)

Default is `false`.

session_id.description: The id of the entire session.

event.const: The type of session event. For this step, a successful response returns `task_started`.

trace_id.description: The ID of a single request within the session, useful for troubleshooting or feedback.

event.description: The type of session event. For this step, set to `task_continue`.

text.description:
Text to be synthesized into speech. Maximum length: 10,000 characters.
- Use line breaks (`\n`) to indicate paragraph changes.
- Pause control: Custom pauses between text segments can be specified. Insert `<#x#>` in the text, where `x` is the pause duration in seconds (range **[0.01, 99.99]**, up to two decimal places). Pause markers must be placed between pronounceable text segments; multiple consecutive pause markers are not allowed.
- **Interjection tags**: Only supported when using `speech-2.8-hd` or `speech-2.8-turbo` models. Supported interjections: `(laughs)`, `(chuckle)`, `(coughs)`, `(clear-throat)`, `(groans)`, `(breath)`, `(pant)`, `(inhale)`, `(exhale)`, `(gasps)`, `(sniffs)`, `(sighs)`, `(snorts)`, `(burps)`, `(lip-smacking)`, `(humming)`, `(hissing)`, `(emm)`, `(sneezes)`.

data.description: `data` may return `null`. Please check for null when referencing example code.

audio.description: Synthesized audio segment, hex-encoded, generated in the format defined in the request (mp3/ pcm/ flac).

speed.description:
Speech speed. Higher values result in faster speech.
Range: `[0.5, 2]` (default: 1.0).

vol.description:
Speech volume. Higher values increase loudness.
Range: `(0, 10]` (default: `1.0`).

pitch.description:
Speech pitch adjustment.
Range: `[-12, 12]` (default: `0`, original pitch).

emotion.description:
Emotion control for synthesized speech. Supported values:  `["happy", "sad", "angry", "fearful", "disgusted", "surprised", "calm", "fluent", "whisper"]`.  
- By default, the model automatically selects the most natural emotion based on text.  Manual specification is only recommended when explicitly needed.  
- Available for models: `speech-2.8-hd`, `speech-2.8-turbo`, `speech-2.6-hd`, `speech-2.6-turbo`, `speech-02-hd`, `speech-02-turbo`, `speech-01-hd`, `speech-01-turbo`.  
- Option `fluent`, `whisper` is only available for models: `speech-2.6-turbo`, `speech-2.6-hd`. `speech-2.8-hd` and `speech-2.8-turbo` do not support `whisper`.

english_normalization.description: Enable text normalization in English. Improves performance in digit-reading scenarios at the cost of slightly higher latency. Default: `false`.

latex_read.description:
Enable LaTeX formula reading. Default: `false`.

- Only supports Chinese. When this parameter is enabled, `language_boost` will be set to `Chinese`.
- Formulas must be wrapped with `$$`.
- If the request contains a formula with `"\"`, it must be escaped as `"\\"`.

Example: The quadratic formula
![The quadratic formula](https://filecdn.minimax.chat/public/d6f62e9a-cd3f-4f55-a237-257eef531683.png)

should be written as `$$x = \\frac{-b \\pm \\sqrt{b^2 - 4ac}}{2a}$$`

sample_rate.description: Specifies the sampling rate of the generated audio. Supported values: `[8000, 16000, 22050, 24000, 32000, 44100]`. Default is `32000`.

bitrate.description:
Specifies the bitrate of the generated audio. Supported values: `[32000, 64000, 128000, 256000]`. Default is `128000`.
*Note: This parameter only applies to audio in `mp3` format.*

format.description:
Specifies the format of the generated audio. Supported values: `[mp3, pcm, flac, wav, pcmu_raw, pcmu_wav, opus]`. Default is `mp3`.
*Note: `pcmu_raw` and `pcmu_wav` are G.711 μ-law encoded (8 kHz sample rate; `pcmu_raw` is headerless raw, `pcmu_wav` is wrapped in a WAV container). `opus` is Ogg/Opus encoded; in streaming mode, audio chunks must be reassembled in arrival order before decoding.*

channel.description: Specifies the number of audio channels. Supported values: `[1, 2]`.  `1` = mono, `2` = stereo. Default is `1`.

tone.description:
Defines pronunciation rules for specific characters or symbols.
For Chinese text, tones are represented numerically:  1 = first tone, 2 = second tone, 3 = third tone, 4 = fourth tone, 5 = neutral tone.
Example: `["omg/oh my god"]`

voice_id.description:
The ID of the voice used for synthesis. Must be specified together with `weight`.
Supports system voices, cloned voices, and text-to-voice generated voices.  The full list of available voices can be viewed on the [System Voice ID List](/faq/system-voice-id) or retrieved programmatically using the [Get Voice API](/api-reference/voice-management-get).

VoiceModify.description:
Voice effects configuration.
Supported audio formats:
1. Non-streaming: mp3, wav, flac
2. Streaming: mp3

pitch.description:
Corresponds to the “Deepen/Brighten” slider on the official page. Range: [-100, 100]. Values closer to -100 produce a deeper voice, while values closer to 100 result in a brighter tone.
![pitch](https://filecdn.minimax.chat/public/75af719d-e126-4297-b3cb-416f382e04ec.png)

intensity.description:
Corresponds to the “Stronger/Softer” slider on the official page. Range: [-100, 100]. Values closer to -100 create a stronger, more forceful sound, while values closer to 100 yield a softer tone.
![intensity](https://filecdn.minimax.chat/public/14015a81-d9c4-459b-9536-15c511aac6c0.png)

timbre.description:
Corresponds to the “Nasal/Crisp” slider on the official page. Range: [-100, 100]. Values closer to -100 produce a fuller, richer sound, while values closer to 100 generate a crisper tone.
![timbre](https://filecdn.minimax.chat/public/86ab8ff8-896c-4254-b181-017d9d14000e.png)

sound_effects.description: Sound effects. Only one can be applied at a time. Options:  `spacious_echo`, `auditorium_echo`, `lofi_telephone`,`robotic`

audio_format.description: Generated audio file format. Options: mp3/pcm/flac.

audio_channel.description: Number of audio channels: 1 = mono, 2 = stereo.

invisible_character_ratio.description: Ratio of illegal characters. If ≤ 10%, audio is generated normally with the ratio returned. Above 10%, an error is triggered.

usage_characters.description: Number of billing characters for this speech generation.

word_count.description: Count of pronounced characters, including Chinese characters, digits, and letters (punctuation excluded).

status_code.description:
Status code, where `0` indicates a successful connection.
For more information, please refer to the [Error Code Reference](/api-reference/errorcode).

- 0: success
- 2202: illegal event
For more information, please refer to the [Error Code Reference](/api-reference/errorcode).

Status code.
- 0: Request successful
- 1000: Unknown error
- 1001: Request timeout
- 1002: Rate limit
- 1004: Authentication failed
- 1039: TPM rate limit triggered
- 1042: Illegal characters > 10%
- 2013: Invalid input parameters
- 2201: Timeout disconnect
- 2202: Illegal event
- 2203: Empty text, skipped
- 2204: Exceeded character limit, skipped
- 2205: Request limit exceeded
For more codes, see [Error Codes](/api-reference/errorcode).

The status code.
- `1000`: Unknown error
- `1001`: Timeout
- `1002`: Rate limit exceeded
- `1004`: Authentication failed
- `1039`: TPM rate limit triggered
- `1042`: More than 10% invalid characters
- `2013`: Invalid input format
- `2201`: Timeout disconnection
For more codes, see [Error Codes](/api-reference/errorcode).
